intro: Hi! You can already read single words and simple signs. Today you read short real texts: menus, opening hours, train timetables, text messages and profiles. You'll also learn scanning: finding one piece of information fast, without reading every word.
teachingNotes: Reading at A1 means understanding short real texts and finding information in them. Always ask the learner to read the question first, then look for the answer. They don't need every word, and answers are short: a word, a time, a price, a day or a name.

Menus, signs and timetables: menus have sections (Snacks, Main dishes, Desserts, Drinks). Mon–Fri means Monday to Friday, so the weekend is NOT included. am = morning, pm = afternoon/evening. Timetables often use the 24-hour clock with a colon (18:30 = 6:30 pm); Indonesia writes a dot (18.30). Learners often mix up DEPARTS (berangkat) and ARRIVES (tiba), and platform (trains) with gate (planes). OUT OF ORDER means rusak; it has nothing to do with ordering food.

Messages and profiles: the name at the end of a message is the writer, so 'I' = that person. Learners often think 'I' is the person who receives it. Messages drop small words ('Home at 8' = I am home at 8). In profiles, 'I'm from Medan' (asal) and 'I live in Surabaya' (tempat tinggal sekarang) are different; this is a common mistake when answering 'Where does she live?'.

Scanning: decide what the answer looks like before you look. Prices start with Rp, times have a colon or am/pm, phone numbers start with 08, days and names start with a capital letter. A typical error is taking the first number they see (the platform number instead of the time, or the price of the wrong dish). Prices: Rp 25.000 (Indonesia) and 25,000 (English texts) are the same.
Times: if a learner reads a time aloud, 'setengah tujuh' is 6:30 = half past six; British 'half seven' is 7:30. On timetables, saying the numbers (six thirty) is always safe.

Limits: the learner knows to be, the present simple and A0 vocabulary. Texts may use short fixed chunks (See you at 7, Call me after 5) but no past simple, no future forms (will, going to), no present perfect and no comparatives or superlatives. Keep texts to 1–6 short lines and use real Indonesian contexts (warung, station, office, Rupiah prices, 08… numbers).

keyPoints.title: Menus, signs and timetables
keyPoints.explanation: Read the headings first: the menu section, the days on a sign, the column titles on a timetable. Then find the line you need. Mon–Fri = Monday to Friday (days are often cut to three letters); am = morning, pm = after 12 noon; departs = berangkat, arrives = tiba.

id.title: Menu, papan tanda, dan jadwal
id.explanation: Baca judul-judulnya dulu: bagian menu, hari di papan tanda, judul kolom di jadwal. Lalu cari baris yang kamu perlukan. Mon–Fri = Monday to Friday (Senin sampai Jumat; nama hari sering disingkat jadi tiga huruf); am = pagi, pm = setelah jam 12 siang; departs = berangkat, arrives = tiba.

keyPoints.title: Messages and profiles
keyPoints.explanation: A message answers who, what, when and where. The name at the end is the writer, so 'I' is that person. A profile gives facts about one person: name, age, where they're from, where they live, job and likes.

examples.en: Sorry, I'm late. I'm on the bus. – Andi
examples.id: Maaf, aku terlambat. Aku di bus. – Andi

examples.en: I'm from Makassar, but I live in Jakarta.
examples.id: Aku berasal dari Makassar, tapi aku tinggal di Jakarta.

id.title: Pesan dan profil
id.explanation: Pesan menjawab siapa, apa, kapan, dan di mana. Nama di akhir pesan adalah penulisnya, jadi 'I' adalah orang itu. Profil memberi fakta tentang satu orang: nama, umur, asal, tempat tinggal, pekerjaan, dan kesukaannya.

keyPoints.title: Scanning: find it fast
keyPoints.explanation: Read the question, decide what the answer looks like, then move your eyes quickly over the text until you see it. Don't stop at words you don't know.

examples.en: How much is the ticket? → look for Rp
What time does it start? → look for am, pm or 00:00
examples.id: Jam berapa mulainya? → cari am, pm atau 00:00

id.title: Scanning: cari dengan cepat
id.explanation: Baca pertanyaannya, tentukan seperti apa bentuk jawabannya, lalu gerakkan matamu dengan cepat di atas teks sampai kamu menemukannya. Jangan berhenti di kata yang tidak kamu tahu.

guidedPractice.prompt: Read the menu at a warung: 'Fried noodles Rp 20.000 · Chicken satay Rp 30.000 · Hot tea Rp 5.000 · Coffee Rp 10.000'. How much is the chicken satay?
guidedPractice.hint: Find the words 'Chicken satay', then look at the number after Rp.

guidedPractice.prompt: Read the bus timetable: 'Bus 5 · Leaves Blok M 07:10 · Arrives Kota 08:05'. What time does the bus leave Blok M?
guidedPractice.hint: Leaves = berangkat. Don't look at the Arrives time.

guidedPractice.prompt: Read the message: 'Mum, I'm at Dewi's house. Home at 8. Rina'. Where is Rina now?
guidedPractice.hint: Rina wrote the message, so 'I' = Rina.

guidedPractice.prompt: Scan the notice: 'English Club · Every Friday · 3 pm · Room 12 · Free for all students'. Which room is the club in?
guidedPractice.hint: Look for the word Room and the number after it.

independentPractice.prompt: Read the profile: 'My name is Andi. I'm a teacher in Bogor. I play badminton on Saturdays.' What is Andi's job?
independentPractice.hint: Look for the word after 'I'm a'.

independentPractice.prompt: Read the ferry timetable: 'Ferry to Bali: 06:00 · 09:00 · 12:00 · 15:00'. You get to the port at 10:00. What time is the next ferry?
A door at the hospital says 'NO ENTRY'. What does it mean in Indonesian?
independentPractice.hint: Entry is like entrance (masuk). NO = dilarang.

assessment.prompt: Read the menu at a café in Bandung: 'Main dishes: Fried rice Rp 25.000 · Chicken soup Rp 22.000 · Drinks: Iced tea Rp 6.000 · Orange juice Rp 15.000'. How much is the chicken soup? Write the price.
assessment.rubric: Correct: Rp 22.000 (any format: 22.000, 22,000, 22000, twenty-two thousand). 'Rp 25.000' (fried rice) or any other price = 0. '22' alone = 50.

assessment.prompt: The lift in your office has a sign on it: 'OUT OF ORDER'. Can you use the lift today? Write yes or no.
assessment.rubric: Correct: no (OUT OF ORDER = rusak, the lift doesn't work). 'yes' = 0.

assessment.prompt: Read the train timetable: 'Bandung → Jakarta (Gambir) · Departs 06:30 · Arrives 09:45 · Platform 2'. What time does the train arrive in Jakarta?
assessment.rubric: Correct: 09:45 (also 9.45, nine forty-five, quarter to ten). '06:30' (the departure time) = 0. '2' (the platform) = 0.

assessment.prompt: Read Budi's message: 'Hi Rina, the team meeting is on Thursday, not Wednesday. Room 3, 10 am. See you there! Budi'. Which day is the meeting?
assessment.rubric: Correct: Thursday. 'Wednesday' = 0 (the message says NOT Wednesday). 'Kamis' (right day, Indonesian) = 70.

assessment.prompt: Read the profile: 'Hi, I'm Sari. I'm 24 and I'm from Medan. I live in Surabaya and I work in a hotel. I love cooking.' Where does Sari live?
assessment.rubric: Correct: Surabaya. 'Medan' = 0 (that's where she is from, not where she lives). 'in a hotel' = 0 (that's where she works).

assessment.prompt: Scan the notice: 'SWIMMING POOL · Open every day 6 am – 8 pm · Adults Rp 30.000 · Children Rp 15.000 · Swimming lessons: Tuesday and Thursday, 4 pm'. On which days are the swimming lessons?
assessment.rubric: Correct: Tuesday and Thursday (both days). Only one of the two days = 50. 'every day' = 0 (that's when the pool is open). 'Selasa dan Kamis' = 70.

assessment.prompt: Scan the advert: 'ROOM FOR RENT · Jl. Dago 15, Bandung · Rp 1.500.000 a month · Free Wi-Fi · Call Pak Hadi: 0812 7788 1234 (after 5 pm)'. What number do you call?
assessment.rubric: Correct: 0812 7788 1234 (spaces don't matter). One wrong digit = 50. '15' (the house number) or the price = 0.

blocks.text: A menu has **sections**: **Snacks**, **Main dishes** (or **Mains**), **Desserts** and **Drinks**. Each line has a dish and a **price**. Read the section title first, then the dish names. Words like **chicken**, **beef**, **fish**, **rice** and **vegetable** tell you what is in the dish.

id.text: Menu punya beberapa **bagian**: **Snacks** (camilan), **Main dishes** atau **Mains** (makanan utama), **Desserts** (makanan penutup) dan **Drinks** (minuman). Setiap baris berisi nama makanan dan **harga**. Baca dulu judul bagiannya, lalu nama makanannya. Kata seperti **chicken**, **beef**, **fish**, **rice** dan **vegetable** memberi tahu isi makanannya.

blocks.text: Prices: Indonesia writes **Rp 25.000** with a dot. Many English menus write **25,000** with a comma. It's the same price: twenty-five thousand.

id.text: Harga: di Indonesia ditulis **Rp 25.000** dengan titik. Banyak menu bahasa Inggris menulis **25,000** dengan koma. Harganya sama: dua puluh lima ribu.

blocks.prompt: A menu says: 'Today's special: Gado-gado Rp 18.000'. What is 'Today's special'?
blocks.explain: Today's special is the special dish of the day, here gado-gado for Rp 18.000. It isn't free: it has a price.

id.explain: Today's special adalah menu spesial hari ini, di sini gado-gado seharga Rp 18.000. Tidak gratis: ada harganya.
id.prompt: Di menu tertulis: 'Today's special: Gado-gado Rp 18.000'. Apa arti 'Today's special'?

blocks.text: At A0 you read one-word signs like OPEN and EXIT. Now read signs with more information. **Opening hours** tell you when a place is open. **Mon–Fri** means Monday to Friday, so Saturday and Sunday are **not** in it. **am** is the morning (before 12 noon) and **pm** is the afternoon and evening. Read the day first, then the time.

id.text: Di A0 kamu sudah membaca papan tanda satu kata seperti OPEN dan EXIT. Sekarang baca papan tanda dengan info lebih banyak. **Opening hours** (jam buka) memberi tahu kapan sebuah tempat buka. **Mon–Fri** artinya Senin sampai Jumat, jadi Sabtu dan Minggu **tidak** termasuk. **am** adalah pagi (sebelum jam 12 siang) dan **pm** adalah siang sampai malam. Baca harinya dulu, lalu jamnya.

blocks.text:
**OUT OF ORDER** has nothing to do with ordering food. It means the lift, the machine or the toilet is broken (rusak). *Order* has two meanings in English: 'pesan' in a restaurant, and 'keadaan baik' here, so *out of order* = not in good condition.

British and American: **lift** (UK) = **elevator** (US). Both mean the same thing.

id.text:
**OUT OF ORDER** tidak ada hubungannya dengan memesan makanan. Artinya lift, mesin atau toiletnya rusak. Kata *order* punya dua arti dalam bahasa Inggris: 'pesan' di restoran, dan 'keadaan baik' di sini, jadi *out of order* = sedang tidak dalam keadaan baik.

Inggris dan Amerika: **lift** (UK) = **elevator** (US). Artinya sama.

blocks.prompt: A shop sign says: 'Open Mon–Sat 10 am – 9 pm'. It's Sunday. Is the shop open?
blocks.explain: Mon–Sat is Monday to Saturday. Sunday is not in it, so the shop is closed on Sunday.

id.explain: Mon–Sat artinya Senin sampai Sabtu. Minggu tidak termasuk, jadi tokonya tutup hari Minggu.
id.prompt: Papan di sebuah toko bertuliskan: 'Open Mon–Sat 10 am – 9 pm'. Hari ini Minggu. Apakah tokonya buka?

blocks.text: A timetable shows **where** (to / from), **when** (**departs** or **leaves**, and **arrives**) and **where to wait** (a **platform** for trains, a **gate** for planes). Read the column titles first. Timetables often use the 24-hour clock: **18:30** is 6:30 pm. English writes a colon (18:30); Indonesia often writes a dot (18.30).

id.text: Jadwal menunjukkan **ke mana** (to / from), **kapan** (**departs** atau **leaves** = berangkat, **arrives** = tiba) dan **di mana menunggu** (**platform** = peron untuk kereta, **gate** = gerbang untuk pesawat). Baca dulu judul kolomnya. Jadwal sering memakai format 24 jam: **18:30** adalah 6:30 pm. Bahasa Inggris memakai titik dua (18:30); di Indonesia sering memakai titik (18.30).

blocks.text:
Don't mix up **departs** and **arrives**. If you want to know when the train **leaves**, look in the **Departs** column, not the Arrives column. **Departs** and **leaves** mean the same: berangkat.

British and American spelling and dates can look different: *cancelled* (UK) = *canceled* (US). A date like *12–14 July* (UK: day, then month) is *July 12–14* in the US. Same dates.

id.text:
Jangan tertukar antara **departs** dan **arrives**. Kalau kamu ingin tahu kapan kereta **berangkat**, lihat kolom **Departs**, bukan kolom Arrives. **Departs** dan **leaves** artinya sama: berangkat.

Ejaan dan tanggal Inggris (UK) dan Amerika (US) bisa terlihat berbeda: *cancelled* (UK) = *canceled* (US). Tanggal seperti *12–14 July* (UK: tanggal dulu, lalu bulan) ditulis *July 12–14* di US. Tanggalnya sama.

blocks.prompt: A board at the airport says: 'GA 404 · Denpasar · Gate C3 · Delayed'. What does 'Delayed' mean?
blocks.explain: Delayed = terlambat / ditunda: the plane leaves later than the time on the board. 'No plane today' is Cancelled.

id.explain: Delayed = terlambat / ditunda: pesawat berangkat lebih lambat dari jam di papan. 'Tidak ada pesawat hari ini' adalah Cancelled.
id.prompt: Papan di bandara bertuliskan: 'GA 404 · Denpasar · Gate C3 · Delayed'. Apa arti 'Delayed'?

blocks.text: A short message answers **who, what, when** and **where**. The name at the end is the **writer**, so **I** in the message is that person. Messages often drop small words: **'Home at 8'** = I am home at 8. A **profile** (on an app, a website or a class page) gives facts about one person: name, age, where they're **from**, where they **live**, job and likes.

id.text: Pesan pendek menjawab **siapa, apa, kapan** dan **di mana**. Nama di akhir pesan adalah **penulisnya**, jadi **I** di dalam pesan adalah orang itu. Pesan sering membuang kata-kata kecil: **'Home at 8'** = I am home at 8 (aku di rumah jam 8). **Profil** (di aplikasi, situs web atau halaman kelas) berisi fakta tentang satu orang: nama, umur, asal (**from**), tempat tinggal (**live**), pekerjaan dan kesukaan.

rows.en: Sorry, I'm late. I'm on the bus. – Andi
rows.id: Maaf, aku terlambat. Aku di bus. – Andi

rows.note: at a bank or in a bank: both are correct

id.note: at a bank atau in a bank: dua-duanya benar

rows.id: Aku suka sepak bola dan musik.

blocks.text:
**From** and **live in** are different. 'I'm from Medan' is where you come from (asal). 'I live in Jakarta' is your home now. Read carefully when a question asks **Where does she live?**

Profiles often give an age like this: *I'm 30* = umurku 30 tahun. English uses **am / is** for age, and *years old* is often left out.

id.text:
**From** dan **live in** itu berbeda. 'I'm from Medan' adalah asalmu. 'I live in Jakarta' adalah tempat tinggalmu sekarang. Baca dengan teliti kalau pertanyaannya **Where does she live?**

Profil sering menulis umur seperti ini: *I'm 30* = umurku 30 tahun. Bahasa Inggris memakai **am / is** untuk umur, dan kata *years old* sering tidak ditulis.

blocks.prompt: Read: 'I'm Agus. I'm 30. I'm from Bali, but I live in Bandung. I'm a nurse.' Where is Agus from?
blocks.explain: 'I'm from Bali' tells you where he comes from. Bandung is where he lives now.

id.explain: 'I'm from Bali' memberi tahu asalnya. Bandung adalah tempat tinggalnya sekarang.
id.prompt: Baca: 'I'm Agus. I'm 30. I'm from Bali, but I live in Bandung. I'm a nurse.' Agus berasal dari mana?

blocks.text: **Scanning** means looking for **one** piece of information, not reading every word. 1) Read the question first. 2) Decide what the answer looks like. 3) Move your eyes quickly over the text until you find it. Each kind of information has a shape: prices start with **Rp**, times have **:** or **am / pm**, phone numbers start with **08**, days and names start with a **capital letter**.

id.text: **Scanning** artinya mencari **satu** informasi saja, bukan membaca setiap kata. 1) Baca pertanyaannya dulu. 2) Tentukan seperti apa bentuk jawabannya. 3) Gerakkan matamu dengan cepat di teks sampai kamu menemukannya. Setiap jenis informasi punya bentuk: harga diawali **Rp**, jam memakai **:** atau **am / pm**, nomor telepon diawali **08**, nama hari dan nama orang diawali **huruf kapital**.

rows.note: look for a place, Room, Platform, Gate

id.note: cari nama tempat, Room, Platform, Gate

blocks.text: When you scan, don't stop at words you don't know. You don't need them! And don't take the first number you see: check the word next to it (Rp, Room, Platform, Gate).

id.text: Saat scanning, jangan berhenti di kata yang tidak kamu tahu. Kamu tidak memerlukannya! Dan jangan langsung ambil angka pertama yang kamu lihat: cek kata di sebelahnya (Rp, Room, Platform, Gate).

blocks.prompt: You want to phone a shop. What do you look for in its advert?
blocks.explain: Phone numbers in Indonesia start with 08 (or +62 8). A word with @ is an email, and Rp is a price.

id.explain: Nomor telepon di Indonesia diawali 08 (atau +62 8). Kata dengan @ adalah email, dan Rp adalah harga.
id.prompt: Kamu mau menelepon sebuah toko. Apa yang kamu cari di iklannya?

resources.title: A restaurant menu
resources.note: Read a café menu with prices and do two short tasks about it.

id.note: Baca menu kafe lengkap dengan harga, lalu kerjakan dua latihan singkat tentangnya.

resources.title: An airport departures board
resources.note: Practise reading times, gates and words like Boarding and Cancelled on a real-style board.

id.note: Latihan membaca jam, gerbang dan kata seperti Boarding dan Cancelled di papan keberangkatan yang mirip aslinya.

resources.title: Text messages to a friend
resources.note: Two friends text to find a time and a place to meet. Read the chat and answer the questions.

id.note: Dua teman berkirim pesan untuk mencari waktu dan tempat bertemu. Baca obrolannya dan jawab pertanyaannya.

id.intro: Hai! Kamu sudah bisa membaca kata tunggal dan papan tanda sederhana. Hari ini kamu membaca teks pendek sungguhan: menu, jam buka, jadwal kereta, pesan singkat dan profil. Kamu juga belajar scanning: menemukan satu informasi dengan cepat, tanpa membaca setiap kata.
suggestedQuestions: Bagaimana membaca format 24 jam di jadwal?
Bagaimana menemukan informasi dengan cepat tanpa membaca setiap kata?

assessment.rst-1: Baca menu di sebuah kafe di Bandung: 'Main dishes: Fried rice Rp 25.000 · Chicken soup Rp 22.000 · Drinks: Iced tea Rp 6.000 · Orange juice Rp 15.000'. Berapa harga chicken soup? Tulis harganya.
assessment.rst-2: Lift di kantormu ada tulisan: 'OUT OF ORDER'. Bisakah kamu memakai lift itu hari ini? Tulis yes atau no.
assessment.rst-3: Baca jadwal kereta: 'Bandung → Jakarta (Gambir) · Departs 06:30 · Arrives 09:45 · Platform 2'. Jam berapa kereta tiba di Jakarta?
assessment.rst-4: Baca pesan dari Budi: 'Hi Rina, the team meeting is on Thursday, not Wednesday. Room 3, 10 am. See you there! Budi'. Rapatnya hari apa? Tulis dalam bahasa Inggris.
assessment.rst-5: Baca profil ini: 'Hi, I'm Sari. I'm 24 and I'm from Medan. I live in Surabaya and I work in a hotel. I love cooking.' Di mana Sari tinggal?
assessment.rst-6: Cari infonya dengan cepat di pengumuman ini: 'SWIMMING POOL · Open every day 6 am – 8 pm · Adults Rp 30.000 · Children Rp 15.000 · Swimming lessons: Tuesday and Thursday, 4 pm'. Hari apa saja ada les renang? Tulis dalam bahasa Inggris.
assessment.rst-7: Cari infonya dengan cepat di iklan ini: 'ROOM FOR RENT · Jl. Dago 15, Bandung · Rp 1.500.000 a month · Free Wi-Fi · Call Pak Hadi: 0812 7788 1234 (after 5 pm)'. Nomor berapa yang kamu telepon?
